items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: I hired her for a few jobs after that.

ctx.x: Joe Williams sang some, and another girl, Ernestine Anderson, who I love. She sang some. I wonder what ever happened to her. She's a marvelous singer. I think she went back to Seattle. I hired her for a few jobs after that. I had -- casuals and I would always call her, because I enjoyed her singing so much.

Those were fabulous days (inaudible) Bob Freedman (maybe we should differentiate him from many other Bob Freedmans. This is the Bob Freedman who had no prior music reputation. He was a retired manufacturer --
